prices: Existing frozen local HKD price files; Alibaba starts at HK listing 2019-11-26, ICBC at 2016-09-06; both end 2026-09-04. No US ADS splice.
shared_rules: Same 70 entry / strictly below 50 exit, monthly review, next tradable open, 400-day financial and 7-day prior FX limits, 200-bar warmup, 70/30 independent sleeves, 0.001 commission and 0.0005 slippage per side as Tencent. No parameter search.

alibaba.label: Original thresholds with explicit issuer accounting mappings
alibaba.quality: Consolidated adjusted EBITA / revenue as the disclosed core operating profitability proxy; it is not identical to Tencent non-IFRS operating margin. All original weights and numeric thresholds retained.
alibaba.growth: Original annual revenue and non-GAAP net income growth from that announcement
alibaba.valuation: Non-GAAP diluted EPS per Hong Kong ordinary share in CNY. FY2019 pre-split per-share or ADS EPS divided by 8 for July 2019 split; later ADS EPS divided by 8. Fiscal years end March 31 and are published in same calendar year.
alibaba.net_cash: Cash and cash equivalents + short-term investments + liquid treasury investments disclosed separately, less current and noncurrent bank borrowings and unsecured/convertible notes; exclude restricted cash, strategic equity stakes and leases. Preserve definition/line-item changes per original release.
alibaba.dividend: Ordinary dividend in USD per post-split ordinary share, consistent numerator and denominator; ratio is currency independent. Special dividends excluded. When prior ordinary DPS is zero, give zero dividend-growth points, including first-time dividends. No invented denominator.
alibaba.dividend_availability: Use only ordinary dividends announced by that annual release. Do not backfill a dividend first announced later in the year.

icbc.label: Bank-specific exploratory variant; not an unchanged transfer of Tencent numerical scoring
icbc.original_model_status: Not applicable: industrial net cash and core operating margin do not have comparable bank meanings. Do not fabricate an original-model return.
icbc.growth: 12.5 * clip(operating income YoY percent / 10) + 12.5 * clip(attributable net profit YoY percent / 10)
icbc.valuation: 25 * clip((1.2 - PB) / 0.8); PB = raw HKD price * prior CNY/HKD / ordinary BVPS CNY. Exclude preference/perpetual capital when calculating common BVPS.
icbc.safety: 5 * clip((CET1 ratio percent - 9) / 4) + 5 * clip((3 - NPL ratio percent) / 2)
icbc.shareholder: 10 * clip(annual ordinary DPS CNY / (raw HKD price * prior CNY/HKD) / 0.08). Use total annual interim + proposed final ordinary DPS known at annual release, never only final after switching to twice-yearly dividends.
icbc.note: Thresholds are research assumptions for bank economics, not claimed regulatory limits or return-optimized parameters. Preserve original-release figures, including then-current Basel/accounting definitions.

validation: Announcement gating, March year-end support, split/ADS currency units, zero prior dividends, bank-specific formulas, source hashes, independent daily score/signal/fill/equity reconciliation, unchanged Tencent output regression.
limitations: Annual-only pilot; no 2026 interim or quarter updates; no claim of untouched out-of-sample validation or statistically reliable alpha. Present all fixed variants regardless of outcome.
